title: Sound picker, round 15: the dungeon mechanisms
intro: The knock target, the ram and the runaway cart (2026-11-23). One option each so far: the builder's defaults, not yet heard by the owner.

groups.name: The mechanisms
groups.note: A throw at the knock target lets the ram or the cart go.

cues.name: Knock target: knocked
cues.where: A thrown thing (or an arrow, or a blast) knocks the target: it spins and lets its mechanism go

options.label: Thwack and latch
options.note: A thrown clay pot smacks a round wooden practice target hanging on a post: one solid hollow wooden thwack with a short iron latch clack right after, close mic, dry, no reverb, no voice

cues.name: Knock target: only a tap
cues.where: The Spear, a Roll or the slime's body touches the target: it does not trip

options.label: Dull wooden knock
options.note: One single dull knock on a thick hollow wooden board, a soft blunt wooden tap, nothing breaks, close mic, dry, no reverb

cues.name: Knock target: armed again
cues.where: Its mechanism is wound back: the target snaps upright

options.label: Wood-and-iron clack
options.note: A wooden board snaps upright and an iron latch clicks shut: one short crisp wood-and-iron clack, mechanical, close mic, dry, no reverb

cues.name: Ram: the shudder
cues.where: The ram is let go: 0.35 s of shudder before the log swings (the tell)

options.label: Timber creak and chains
options.note: A heavy timber frame creaks and thick iron chains rattle briefly as a huge hanging log shudders, about to be let go, half a second, close mic, dry

cues.name: Ram: the swing
cues.where: The log swings out along its lane

options.label: Deep whoosh
options.note: A huge heavy wooden log swings fast through the air on chains: one deep low whoosh with a faint chain jingle, half a second, no impact, dry

cues.name: Ram: the blow
cues.where: The log reaches the end of its swing, or strikes something on its lane

options.label: Boom and clank
options.note: An iron-capped battering ram log slams hard to the end of its chains: one deep heavy wooden boom with a short iron clank, punchy, short tail, dry, no reverb

cues.name: Ram and cart: the ratchet
cues.where: The winch pulls the log back (8 s), or the counterweight hauls the cart back: one click each time

options.label: Iron tick
options.note: One single click of a heavy iron ratchet pawl dropping onto a cog wheel tooth, a short dry metallic tick, close mic, no reverb

cues.name: Cart: the brake snaps
cues.where: The cart's brake is knocked off: the lever snaps back and the chock is kicked away

options.label: Clack and scrape
options.note: A wooden brake lever snaps back and a wooden wedge is kicked off an iron rail: one sharp wooden clack with a short iron scrape, close mic, dry, no reverb

cues.name: Cart: rolling (a loop)
cues.where: The cart rolls down its line (the game raises its pitch as it speeds up) and is hauled back

options.label: Rattling wheels and ore
options.note: A small loaded iron mine cart rolling fast along iron rails, steady rattling wheels and clattering ore rocks, continuous, close mic, dry, seamless loop

options.label: Heavy rumble and joint clatter
options.note: Heavy wooden mine cart loaded with ore rolling fast on iron rails in a stone tunnel: deep low rumble of iron wheels, rhythmic clack of the wheels over the rail joints, rocks jostling in the cart, continuous and steady, close mic, dry, no voice, no music (5 s, loop; cut to a 3.3 s loop)

cues.name: Cart: the bump
cues.where: The cart reaches its buffer stop, or rams something

options.label: Clang, thud and ore
options.note: A loaded mine cart crashes to a dead stop against a wooden buffer: one heavy iron clang and wooden thud, then ore rocks rattling and settling, one second, dry
